items.title: An equivalence of abelian categories induces an equivalence of bounded below derived categories of weak Serre subcategories

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma upgrades an equivalence of weak Serre subcategories of modules to an equivalence of their bounded below derived categories, for a flat morphism of ringed topoi (statement lines 6390-6408). The proof passes the pullback to the derived categories using exactness and the preservation of the subcategories (proof lines 6410-6420), and then uses the unit and counit identifications to conclude that the two functors are quasi-inverse (proof lines 6420-6431). The non-formal content is the passage from an equivalence of abelian subcategories to one of their derived categories. The claim is H2: a short categorical argument, written out.
